name: Mech-Mind Robotics
summary: Mech-Mind Robotics develops industrial 3D cameras and software that enable robots to perceive objects and execute manipulation tasks. Its portfolio includes Mech-Eye cameras, machine-vision and robot-programming software, and integrated robotic stations. Its systems support industrial work such as bin picking, machine tending, assembly, inspection and palletizing. The company maintains an office in Beijing and other locations in China and overseas.
